Identify, approach, counsel and follow up prospective students in Malta and internationally. Develop relationships with education agents, education consultants, colleges, training providers and other potential recruitment partners. Identify and develop new institutional partnerships and approved study-centre opportunities. Follow up student and partnership opportunities from initial contact through to enrolment or successful collaboration. Build and maintain a professional network within the education sector. Work towards agreed monthly student recruitment and partnership-development targets. Identify relevant education fairs, recruitment events and networking opportunities in Malta and internationally. Represent West Business School professionally at education fairs, meetings, recruitment events and networking activities where required. Malta Operations & Institutional Administration Support the day-to-day operations of West Business School in Malta. Act as an important point of coordination between management and external stakeholders in Malta. Attend meetings, appointments and operational visits when required. Coordinate institutional documentation, records, registers and administrative requirements. Liaise with accountants, auditors, corporate service providers, banks, professional advisers, landlords, suppliers and other external stakeholders. Support company filings and general corporate administration. Maintain accurate records of outstanding matters, deadlines and follow-ups. Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion. Compliance & Quality Assurance Support institutional regulatory and compliance activities. Assist with MFHEA-related documentation, correspondence and quality-assurance requirements. Support preparation and maintenance of documentation required for regulatory reviews, monitoring and audits. Track regulatory and administrative deadlines and promptly escalate matters requiring management input. HR & Recruitment Support management with staff recruitment and HR administration. Coordinate job advertisements, candidate screening, interviews and candidate follow-ups. Participate in candidate interviews when required. Ensure scheduled interviews and appointments are professionally managed and attended. Assist with employee onboarding and employment documentation. Accountability & Working Style This position requires a high degree of personal responsibility, reliability and follow-through . The successful candidate will be expected to: take ownership of assigned responsibilities and complete agreed actions; attend scheduled meetings, interviews and appointments reliably and punctually; provide regular progress updates without requiring repeated follow-up from management; submit a concise weekly activity and progress report; promptly communicate when a task is completed, delayed or requires management input; manage multiple priorities and deadlines in an organised manner; distinguish clearly between correspondence requiring action and correspondence shared for information/familiarisation; adapt to changing operational priorities within a growing higher-education institution; and communicate professionally with students, candidates, colleagues, partners, regulators, professional advisers and management. Candidate Profile Candidates should demonstrate: Relevant experience in higher education, student recruitment, admissions, education consultancy, business development, institutional operations or a related environment . Strong organisational and follow-up skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities. Strong interpersonal and relationship-development skills. Confidence approaching prospective students, education agents and institutional partners. Commercial awareness and willingness to work towards agreed recruitment and partnership targets. Excellent written and spoken English. Professional and dependable communication. Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and deadlines. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and online communication platforms. Particularly Desirable Preference in the selection process will be given to candidates demonstrating relevant professional experience in areas such as: the Maltese higher-education sector ; student admissions and recruitment in Malta; international student recruitment; education agents and institutional partnerships; MFHEA-related administration or institutional compliance; corporate or institutional administration; HR and staff recruitment; and education fairs and international business development. An established professional network within the Maltese education sector and/or international student recruitment market would be a strong advantage. Location & Work Eligibility This is a Malta-based position requiring regular physical presence in Malta. Applicants must: currently reside in Malta; have the existing legal right to work in Malta; be available to attend meetings, appointments, recruitment activities and operational requirements physically in Malta; and be able to commence employment within a reasonable timeframe. This position is not being offered on a remote or relocation basis. Occasional international travel may be required for education fairs, recruitment activities, institutional meetings and business-development opportunities. Important Information Before Applying This is not a purely administrative, compliance or back-office position . Student recruitment, business development and institutional partnership development are important and measurable components of the role. Candidates should therefore be comfortable proactively approaching prospective students and potential partners, following up opportunities and working towards agreed recruitment and partnership objectives alongside their operational, administrative, compliance and HR responsibilities. The position is particularly suited to someone who enjoys a varied role, takes responsibility for outcomes and is comfortable acting as an important operational point of contact for a higher-education institution in Malta. Application Please apply through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV highlighting your relevant experience in higher education, student recruitment, business development and/or institutional operations . Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in the next stage of the selection process.
